materials: Active-pack brick/plank blocks, anvil metal for controller frame, blast-furnace hatch face, pack coal and fire. No new generated raster; all cut structure geometry is native half-grid.

review.silhouette: Existing forge retained. User-directed dimensional refinement: table is exactly 2 wide, 1.5 deep and 1 high, using upper slabs/quarter beams and four lower eighth feet sharing block spaces. Reviewed front/back under Photon. Mockup-03 remains the earlier forge/rear direction; its tall table is superseded by the explicit dimension brief.
review.construction: 9 bricks, 14 brick halves, 8 brick beams, 4 brick eighths, 2 plank halves, 2 plank beams, 4 plank eighths, one stone footing and one anvil plus controller.
review.operation: Animated fire/chimney smoke observed during work; extinguished when blocked. Decorative coal bed is not a real block/item. Controller frame darkened after initial review.
review.guide: Missing anvil appears as native translucent anvil model with one missing-block HUD; rear masonry and open bench inspected.
review.validation: Build/unit, 166 server GameTests and Photon workshop scene passed in 51.1s; exact table bounds, four feet, sibling-piece guide eligibility and existing all-facing checks.
review.limits: Existing shells require manual reshaping. Renderer aboard moving Sable vessels not tested; no new moving-vessel support claimed.
